defmodule SecureDNS.Resolver do
  @moduledoc """
  DNS resolver with encrypted cache storage and IDN support.
  Uses AES-256-GCM for cache encryption at rest.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @aes_key :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  @aes_iv_len 12
  @cache_ttl 300_000

  defstruct [:cache_table, :encryption_key, :trusted_domains]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    table = :ets.new(:dns_cache, [:set, :private])
    trusted = Keyword.get(opts, :trusted_domains, ["example.com", "internal.corp"])
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{cache_table: table, encryption_key: @aes_key, trusted_domains: trusted}}
  end

  def resolve(domain) when is_binary(domain) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:resolve, domain})
  end

  def handle_call({:resolve, domain}, _from, state) do
    normalized = normalize_domain(domain)
    case lookup_cache(normalized, state) do
      {:ok, record} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, record}, state}
      :miss ->
        case perform_dns_lookup(normalized) do
          {:ok, record} ->
            if domain_trusted?(normalized, state.trusted_domains) do
              store_cache(normalized, record, state)
              {:reply, {:ok, record}, state}
            else
              {:reply, {:error, :untrusted_domain}, state}
            end
          error ->
            {:reply, error, state}
        end
    end
  end

  defp normalize_domain(domain) do
    domain
    |> String.trim()
    |> String.downcase()
    |> decode_idn()
    |> strip_trailing_dot()
  end

  defp decode_idn(domain) do
    parts = String.split(domain, ".")
    parts
    |> Enum.map(&decode_idn_label/1)
    |> Enum.join(".")
  end

  defp decode_idn_label("xn--" <> _rest = label) do
    case punycode_decode(label) do
      {:ok, decoded} -> decoded
      :error -> label
    end
  end
  defp decode_idn_label(label), do: label

  defp punycode_decode("xn--" <> encoded) do
    try do
      decoded = :idna.decode(String.to_charlist("xn--" <> encoded))
      {:ok, List.to_string(decoded)}
    rescue
      _ -> :error
    end
  end

  defp strip_trailing_dot(domain) do
    String.trim_trailing(domain, ".")
  end

  defp domain_trusted?(normalized_domain, trusted_domains) do
    # Check if the normalized domain matches or is a subdomain of trusted domains
    Enum.any?(trusted_domains, fn trusted ->
      visual_match?(normalized_domain, trusted)
    end)
  end

  defp visual_match?(domain, trusted) do
    # Compare using canonical form - normalize Unicode to catch homoglyphs
    canonical_domain = canonicalize(domain)
    canonical_trusted = canonicalize(trusted)
    canonical_domain == canonical_trusted or
      String.ends_with?(canonical_domain, "." <> canonical_trusted)
  end

  defp canonicalize(domain) do
    # NFC normalization for consistent comparison
    domain
    |> String.normalize(:nfc)
    |> String.to_charlist()
    |> Enum.map(&normalize_codepoint/1)
    |> List.to_string()
  end

  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0430], do: ?a  # Cyrillic а -> Latin a
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0435], do: ?e  # Cyrillic е -> Latin e
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x043E], do: ?o  # Cyrillic о -> Latin o
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0440], do: ?p  # Cyrillic р -> Latin p
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0441], do: ?c  # Cyrillic с -> Latin c
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0443], do: ?y  # Cyrillic у -> Latin y (WRONG: у=u visually)
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0445], do: ?x  # Cyrillic х -> Latin x
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp) when cp in [0x0456], do: ?i  # Ukrainian і -> Latin i
  defp normalize_codepoint(cp), do: cp

  defp lookup_cache(domain, state) do
    case :ets.lookup(state.cache_table, domain) do
      [{^domain, encrypted_record, timestamp}] ->
        if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - timestamp < @cache_ttl do
          {:ok, decrypt_record(encrypted_record, state.encryption_key)}
        else
          :ets.delete(state.cache_table, domain)
          :miss
        end
      [] ->
        :miss
    end
  end

  defp store_cache(domain, record, state) do
    encrypted = encrypt_record(record, state.encryption_key)
    timestamp = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    :ets.insert(state.cache_table, {domain, encrypted, timestamp})
  end

  defp encrypt_record(record, key) do
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@aes_iv_len)
    plaintext = :erlang.term_to_binary(record)
    {ciphertext, tag} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(
      :aes_256_gcm, key, iv, plaintext, <<>>, true
    )
    iv <> tag <> ciphertext
  end

  defp decrypt_record(<<iv::binary-size(12), tag::binary-size(16), ciphertext::binary>>, key) do
    plaintext = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(
      :aes_256_gcm, key, iv, ciphertext, <<>>, tag, false
    )
    :erlang.binary_to_term(plaintext, [:safe])
  end

  defp perform_dns_lookup(domain) do
    case :inet_res.lookup(String.to_charlist(domain), :in, :a) do
      [] -> {:error, :nxdomain}
      ips -> {:ok, %{domain: domain, addresses: ips, resolved_at: DateTime.utc_now()}}
    end
  end
end
